architecture.determinism: Single fit only. Pin versions/seed. Export tree, medians, indicators. Independently verify weighted node moments and best eligible split using saved TRAIN labels; no real-data refit in tests or CI.

labels.fiveTimesOpportunityLossProbability: 5*I(any k in [3,5]: now common-end MFE>=k and next common-end MFE<k OR now exact FAST_WINNER and next_OPEN>now_OPEN)
labels.strict30MAEImprovementPP: next own-entry strict30 MAE minus current own-entry strict30 MAE

architecture.noOracle: No future minimum/maximum entry search. Only current and one scheduled-next purchase evaluation. Missing labels excluded, not failure/zero.
architecture.reason: One bounded joint tree learns limited context interactions for local price/risk improvement. BUY is default and cap forces BUY; no learned SKIP. Opportunity-loss guard protects winners. Unlike v2, no utility-versus-cash comparison or negative trade filtering. No claim of optimal control or calibrated probabilities.
architecture.training: TRAIN baseline common60-complete first-selection symbol-session only. State delays0 and5 (WATCH-eligible); exactly-next5m executable OPEN outcome. Each episode total weight1 across eligible states. Future outcome fields kept in label file only.
architecture.weights: Fixed loss target multiplier5, joint squared_error; no weight/threshold/model rescue.

decision.PIT: Policy projection uses raw saved DecisionPrice (known CLOSE) as state reference, not future execution OPEN. Bars end<=t only. Exact score/rank and snapshot timestamp retained. Prefix must be contiguous regular5m from anchor.
decision.execution: After fixed action BUY, scheduled regular bar starting decision timestamp OPEN only. Never completed signal LOW/CLOSE. UNKNOWN_INTRABAR_ORDER maintained. No provider publication latency claim beyond saved completed semantics.
decision.expiry: Only invalid snapshot, session/window boundary, missing completed prefix, or missing executable OPEN. Critical missing state is terminal for symbol-session. Optional feature missing ->TRAIN median+indicator.
decision.rule: If valid and d<10 and next5m decision lies strictly before current window/segment end, WATCH only when predicted price improvement>=.10 AND lossScore/5<=.10 AND predicted strict30 MAE improvement>=0; otherwise BUY_NOW. At cap or last eligible decision BUY_NOW regardless model. No model SKIP, no performance-based expiry.

historicalComparison.note: DIP absence is a missing historical event, not a SKIP policy. Direct policy population is not restricted to DIP.

rawStateDiagnostic.scope: TRAIN descriptive repeated observations; not independent trades and not a runtime rule.
